body:
Kanban priority queue, card GFD-124433: GFD needs per-job leveling -- a level-10 WAR switching
to RDM for the first time should start RDM at level 1, level it independently, and switch back
to WAR at its own real level 10.

New character_job_levels table + GET/PATCH /api/v1/characters/:id/job-levels[/:job] (agent-only,
same cheat-vector reasoning as the existing /level endpoint). characters.level/current_xp kept
as a "currently-active job" mirror for other consumers. 5 new tests. go build/vet/test ./... clean.
